item.title: Contextual reminders use the capable model
item.summary: Murph now keeps simple fixed cues on the lightweight path and uses the more capable model when a reminder needs current context, interpretation, or judgment.
item.details: Straightforward fixed cues stay quick. Reminders that need history, current data, tools, personalization, ambiguity resolution, or safety judgment use Terra; existing saved reminders keep their current model unless their instructions or context requirements materially change.

tryIt.label: Set a contextual reminder
tryIt.prompt: Every day at 6 PM, review my latest workout and recovery data and remind me whether to train or recover.
